property.name: tez.lib.uris
property.description: URI of the Tez tarball on HDFS. YARN uses this to distribute Tez libraries to all containers that run Tez ApplicationMasters and tasks.

property.name: tez.use.cluster.hadoop-libs
property.description: Use the Hadoop libraries present on the cluster (NodeManager classpath) rather than bundling them inside the Tez tarball. Required when running Tez 0.10.x against Hadoop 3.x to avoid class conflicts.
